news.story: Green delivered an efficient offensive performance Tuesday, scoring nine points on 4-for-5 shooting, including his lone three-point attempt. Despite the improved scoring, his reduced playing time in Utah's rotation limits his fantasy appeal outside deeper leagues.

news.headline: Wemby leads Spurs to victory with 50-point, 19-rebound night
Wembanyama finished with 50 points (20-29 FG, 5-11 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 19 rebounds, one assist, four steals and five blocks across 32 minutes in Saturday's 114-91 win over the Pelicans.
news.story: Wembanyama had his third career game with at least 50 points, tying David Robinson for the second-most in Spurs history. He also became the first player since 1973-74 to record at least 50 points, 15 rebounds, four steals and five blocks in a game. The 2023 No. 1 overall pick is having another MVP-caliber year and is now averaging 29.9 points, 12.4 rebounds, 1.3 steals and 3.9 blocks, all career highs, along with…

news.headline: Indiana Pacers vs. Cleveland Cavaliers: Game Highlights
James Harden cooks the Pacers for 51 points in Cavs win
Harden erupted for 51 points (15-for-26 FG, 7-11 3Pt, 14-14 FT), six rebounds, six assists and one steal across 40 minutes during Friday's 128-119 win over Indiana.
news.story: Harden couldn't be stopped Friday, as he scored a game- and season-high 51 points to lead Cleveland to a 14-point comeback win. The scoring marks Harden's highest effort since November 2025, giving him 21 outings with 50-plus to go along with four 60-point performances. Per NBA.com, the 37-year-old passed Kobe Bryant for the third-most 50-point games on the NBA's all-time list.

news.story: Harden couldn't be stopped Friday, as he scored a game- and season-high 51 points to lead Cleveland to a 14-point comeback win.
